Battery-wide analyses of the current data: the network and what the
release contains, growth, construct structure, battery length,
test–retest and cross-language item functioning, and the downward extension
to ages 2–5. Pages are moving from the 2026-08 per-site snapshot to the
pinned `levante_data_latest` release, and each page states its data.

Release-level reliability, age and test–retest summaries for every task and
dataset are on the [LEVANTE datapage](https://levante-framework.github.io/levante-datapage).
